policy: Offline real copied-save audit. Player names, profile fields, save IDs, storage and authentication are omitted. Possible counts include capability rows; own obligations are counted separately. Source reductions preserve free activities where a valid source survives. Unknown membership remains review evidence, never an inferred prohibition.

beforeHashConvention.repositoryText: sha256: raw working-tree bytes (immutable original baseline)

limitations: Saved membership and challenge-completion facts were evaluated in a copied snapshot, not live character membership.
A member node in a transitive graph is supporting evidence; optional aliases and mixed sources require the recorded after blockers to assess causal necessity.
Unmatched source records are an exhaustive review queue, not automatically member-only content.

classificationDefinitions.a: Removed intrinsically members-only activities, member-only product activities and members-only equipment goals.
classificationDefinitions.b: Removed supply/source/transitive-dependent obligations plus surviving free tasks with a reduced member source set; free items can become unobtainable without becoming member items.
classificationDefinitions.c: False-positive safeguards: free quests/areas, free dragons, free logs and valid alternatives remain allowed; unresolved removals are review candidates, not asserted member-only activities.

player-1.classCSafeguardScope: Enumerated identity, source, currency and preserved method/quest probes; not subtracted from possible-task losses or class-b optional paths.

player-2.classCSafeguardScope: Enumerated identity, source, currency and preserved method/quest probes; not subtracted from possible-task losses or class-b optional paths.
